{{Quote|Permit me to introduce myself, Baron Davin DeWitt, the administrator.|Davin DeWitt|<ref name="Find the Lady">{{LivingForce|Trade Wars: Find the Lady}}</ref>}}
'''Davin DeWitt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
DeWitt was the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of the [[platform city]] [[Bayonard]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], his daughter, [[Selima DeWitt]], went missing and Davin became determined to find her. He sent the messenger [[Brian]] to collect the [[heroes of Cularin]] and bring them to see him, in his house on Bayonard He then explained to the heroes the details about his daughter's' disappearance and then hired them to find her and ask her to come back.
